_comment: Shared build-time settings, read by render.js and exposed to every template as {{site.*}}. Add keys; do not rename existing ones without telling the other team. Values marked ASSUMED are awaiting the user.

repo._note: ASSUMED default. Used by the card 'View on Github' link (Catalog team) and the About page GitHub link (Shell team). For the demo the build may override with --repo-url/--repo-branch.

links._note: Shell team. The GitHub link on the About page is NOT here: it is built from repo.url (Q-10, one setting). tiny.cc is a third-party short-link dependency (user-owned).

intro.text: The Methodology Library is Guardian's collection of ready-to-use policies and schemas that already digitize real-world environmental methodologies and standards. It is the world's largest open-source repository of digital environmental policies, spanning CDM, Verra, Gold Standard, GHG Protocol, iREC, and community-contributed methodologies.
intro._note: B-06 snapshot of the first paragraph (two sentences, verbatim) of the source page, copied from the local docs file, not fetched. USER MUST APPROVE THE WORDING. It can go stale: whoever publishes the site refreshes it by re-copying the opening paragraph and updating snapshotDate. Edit only here.
